stories.title: NTA clarifies JEE Main 2027 category selection
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has issued guidance on category selection for JEE Main 2027 registration. The advisory targets Indian nationals and international applicants without Aadhaar cards. Candidates have until November 22 to submit applications without a late fee. The deadline is approaching for those who have not applied.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 registration figures released
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency reports 786,687 submitted registration forms for JEE Main 2027. Of these, 594,259 candidates have completed the required examination fee payment. Applicants who have yet to finish the process are advised to pay their fees and download the confirmation page.

stories.title: Vignan University opens V-SAT 2027 admissions
stories.summary: Vignan University has announced its 2027-28 admission process for undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Vice-Chancellor K.V. Krishna Kishore stated the university aims to prepare students for high-paying jobs and entrepreneurship. Entrance exams for B.Tech and pharmacy courses will run from January 1 to March 31, 2027.

CUET UG 2027 proposes exam pattern changes
stories.summary: Proposed changes for CUET UG 2027 include selecting fewer subjects and condensing the examination into a single day. The updates aim to reduce the burden of repeated centre visits for students. The examination process remains subject to ongoing adjustments as students prepare for their upcoming entrance requirements.

stories.title: IIT Delhi sets JEE Advanced 2027 for May 23
stories.summary: IIT Delhi will conduct the JEE Advanced 2027 examination on May 23, 2027. The institute has launched an official website to serve as the primary information portal for candidates. Eligibility criteria and examination updates are now available for students planning to secure admission to the IITs.

stories.title: RBSE Board Exam 2027: Rajasthan Board Class 10, 12 Exams Postponed Due to Census Work, New Date Soon - Shiksha.com
JEE Main 2027 registration nears November 22 deadline
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has recorded 786,687 applications for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. As of November 14, 594,259 candidates have completed their fee payments. Aspirants have until November 22 to submit their forms without incurring a late fee.

stories.title: IIT Delhi announces JEE Advanced 2027 date
stories.summary: IIT Delhi has scheduled the JEE Advanced 2027 examination for May 23, 2027. The institute has released eligibility rules and information regarding calculator facilities on its official website. Registration dates for the examination have not yet been announced.

stories.title: JEE Advanced 2027 website goes live
stories.summary: IIT Delhi launched the official JEE Advanced 2027 website on November 13. The examination is scheduled for May 23, 2027. Candidates can now access eligibility rules and examination details via the portal. The institute has advised students to monitor the site for further updates.

stories.title: UK international student visa applications drop 20 percent
stories.summary: Home Office figures show a 20 percent decline in international student visa applications over the past year. A total of 349,900 main applicants applied for visas. The drop follows tighter immigration rules, increased refusals and ongoing uncertainty regarding post-study work opportunities in the UK.

stories.title: Kenya High Commissioner addresses visa changes
stories.summary: The Kenyan High Commissioner to Australia has issued a statement regarding opportunities for students and skilled workers. The message follows recent visa policy changes. The Kenyan Diaspora Media confirmed the communication was released to address concerns within the community regarding ongoing international mobility.

stories.title: Canada immigration plan update
stories.summary: The Canadian government has introduced a new immigration plan affecting international student intake. Details regarding the policy were not accessible due to a server configuration error. The official status of the intake cap remains part of the broader federal immigration framework.

stories.title: Global study visa refusals rise
stories.summary: Government agencies are increasing compliance checks for international study visas. Refusal rates have spiked in the UK, while Canada reports visa issuance at low levels. Officials are trained to identify false pretences, resulting in stricter scrutiny for applicants across multiple international jurisdictions.

stories.title: Australia tightens Subclass 485 visa rules
stories.summary: The Department of Home Affairs has restricted the family members eligible to accompany graduates on a Temporary Graduate visa. Effective November 13, 2026, partners or children may only be included if they held a dependent visa on a previous student or graduate permit.

stories.title: Canada's New Immigration Plan Will Allow Only 1.5 Lakh International Students Annually Until 2029 - NDTV Profit
UK Business Schools See 18% Drop In Overseas Enrolments Following Visa Changes - NDTV Profit
Canada sets annual target of 150,000 new international students through 2029
stories.summary: Canada plans to welcome 150,000 new international students and 220,000 temporary workers annually from 2027 to 2029. The targets are part of the government's latest immigration levels plan, which aims to manage temporary resident arrivals while meeting labour market needs. The government has set an overall annual target of 370,000.

stories.title: US and UK see decline in international student enrolments
stories.summary: A survey by Studyportals, NAFSA and Oxford Test of English found international undergraduate enrolments fell 19 percent in the UK and 13 percent in the US between October and August. Students are increasingly choosing universities in Asia and continental Europe as visa rules and immigration policies tighten.

stories.title: Visa restrictions shift international student interest to Asia
stories.summary: International students are increasingly choosing universities in Asia and continental Europe over institutions in the US and Britain. A global survey of 437 universities found that the US and Britain recorded the steepest declines in international undergraduate enrolments between October and August compared with the previous year.

stories.title: UK student visa applications fall by 31 percent
stories.summary: UK student visa applications declined by 31 percent in October compared with the same month last year. Factors influencing the drop include university recruitment decisions, rising travel and living costs, and changes to post-study work rights, according to an article in Times Higher Education.

stories.title: Malta increases student visa fees for non-EU applicants
stories.summary: Malta's Bill 15 proposes increasing residence permit fees for non-EU students from 50 euros to 500 euros starting in 2027. Finance Minister Clyde Caruana linked the hikes to the country's plan to reduce reliance on third-country nationals. The new charges take effect in 2027.

stories.title: Confederation College awards entrance scholarships
stories.summary: Three freshmen international students at Confederation College received entrance scholarships totalling 13,000 dollars. The college director of international, Patrick Carr, stated that applicants were selected based on criteria including academic excellence, leadership, practical problem-solving skills and community service. The college reported a diverse and competitive applicant pool.

stories.title: Regional education grants open for NSW students
stories.summary: Applications are open for the Glenn Taylor Scholarship, offering up to 20,000 dollars to assist regional and rural students in New South Wales pursuing vocational or university qualifications. The scholarship is funded by OCTEC to support students in rural areas with their educational costs.

stories.title: Shanghai Jiao Tong University opens postgraduate applications
stories.summary: Shanghai Jiao Tong University has opened applications for international Master's and PhD programmes for the 2027 academic year. The university is inviting students from different countries to apply for research opportunities. Applications officially opened on 5 November 2026 for prospective students interested in advanced studies in China.

stories.title: India invites applications for tribal student scholarships
stories.summary: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs has invited applications for the National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students for the 2026-27 academic year. Selected students receive tuition support and an annual stipend of 36,000 rupees. Applications are open until November 30 for eligible undergraduate and postgraduate students.

stories.title: UGC opens Ishan Uday scholarship for North Eastern students
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission is inviting applications for the Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for the 2026-27 academic year. The scheme provides 80,000 rupees annually to students from India's eight North Eastern states. Approximately 10,000 fresh scholarships are available, with a deadline of November 30.

stories.title: University of Leeds offers fully funded PhD scholarships
stories.summary: The University of Leeds is offering three postgraduate research scholarships for the 2027 academic year. The funding includes full tuition fees and a 21,805 pound annual stipend for UK and international students pursuing a PhD in performance, cultural industries and related fields. Applications are currently open.

stories.title: Last date for submission of applications under the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme for academic year 2026-27
Scan Design Foundation offers environmental internship in Denmark
stories.summary: The Scan Design Foundation is offering 12 fully funded environmental sustainability internships in Copenhagen for US students. The programme is open to undergraduate and graduate students interested in climate action and international development. Applications for the 2027 internship must be submitted by 20 November 2026.

stories.title: NAPB-APBA offers PhD scholarships for African plant breeding students
stories.summary: The NAPB-APBA Borlaug Scholars-Africa Programme is offering six fully funded scholarships to African PhD students in plant breeding. The two-year programme aims to support doctoral researchers through financial aid, professional mentorship and international exposure. The initiative seeks to nurture the next generation of plant breeding scientists.

stories.title: Seoul National University to launch Global Talent Division
stories.summary: Seoul National University is preparing to launch a Global Talent Division for international students. The plan includes scholarships for the first three semesters and intensive Korean-language training before students declare a major. The university intends to admit students without requiring an initial major declaration.

stories.title: Bet9ja Foundation opens 2027 undergraduate scholarship
stories.summary: The Bet9ja Foundation has opened applications for its 2027 Undergraduate Scholarship for Nigerian students in public universities. Applicants must be in their third or fourth year with a minimum CGPA of 4.0. The programme covers STEM, law, medicine, humanities and administration. Applications close on November 24, 2026.

stories.title: Dr. Kazem Kazempour scholarship opens for healthcare students
stories.summary: The Dr. Kazem Kazempour Scholarship is accepting applications from undergraduate students pursuing careers in medicine, biomedical science, public health and related healthcare fields. The one-time award supports students committed to research and evidence-based practice at accredited US colleges and universities. Applications opened on November 13, 2026.

stories.title: Universities divided over uniform entry test as UGC drops push - www.daily-sun.com
Top U.S. universities across three major rankings
stories.summary: MIT leads U.S. institutions in both Forbes and QS rankings, while Harvard holds the top spot on the ARWU list. Sixteen U.S. universities appear in the top 25 across all three lists. Rankings offer different perspectives, provided you choose the right one to look at.

stories.title: How Does Iona University Rank Among America's Best Colleges? - U.S. News & World Report
HEC trains representatives of 40 universities on QS rankings
stories.summary: The Higher Education Commission of Pakistan held a capacity-building programme for representatives from 40 universities. The initiative aimed to help institutions understand ranking methodologies and improve data reporting. Participation in global rankings is now a formal administrative exercise.

stories.title: HEC urges universities to participate in QS World University Rankings 2028
stories.summary: The Higher Education Commission of Pakistan has written to university heads, urging them to participate in the QS World University Rankings 2028. While performance has been described as encouraging, the commission noted that overall participation remains limited. Data submission is now a priority.

stories.title: University of Tashkent for Applied Sciences enters QS 2027 rankings
stories.summary: The University of Tashkent for Applied Sciences has entered the QS Asia University Rankings 2027, marking its first inclusion. The institution recorded its highest scores in the International Research Network indicator. Non-state universities are now part of the international education landscape.

stories.title: Hong Kong urged to look beyond university rankings to attract global students - South China Morning Post
NIRF 2026 ranking list for engineering colleges
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education is expected to release the NIRF 2026 rankings for engineering colleges in November. The list will categorise institutions into ranking bands to help candidates compare performance metrics. The results will be available on the official NIRF website once published.

stories.title: IIT Kharagpur MD programmes get NMC nod
stories.summary: IIT Kharagpur will offer six MD programmes with 12 seats starting in the 2026-27 academic session. This marks the first time an Indian Institute of Technology has entered postgraduate medical education. The institute received accreditation from the National Medical Commission.

stories.title: BIM Trichy and UT Arlington Redefine International Education: US Master's Degree in AI for Business Comes to India - Ind
Expansion is no longer enough for Indian universities
stories.summary: India's higher education enrolment reached 4.5 crore students in 2023-24, according to AISHE data. While the system is expanding, future standing will depend on faculty strength, research output, and student outcomes. Quantity is no longer the only metric for success.

stories.title: Louisiana System head resigns amid tax issue
stories.summary: University of Louisiana System President Rick Gallot resigned on Friday, one day after reports surfaced that he owed $350,000 in federal income taxes. His resignation is effective December 1st, 2026. He will continue to support the system transition until his return to faculty.

stories.title: New Mexico State University hosts American Homecoming Ball
stories.summary: New Mexico State University’s Education Abroad Ambassadors hosted a ball on November 5 to introduce international exchange students to American homecoming traditions. The event featured American food and music. Traditions are now being formally introduced to visitors.

stories.title: Sat Sharma says NC must focus on governance
stories.summary: Jammu and Kashmir BJP president Sat Sharma stated that the National Conference should accept the constitutional position following the abrogation of Article 370. He urged the party to focus on governance rather than revisiting settled issues. Political slogans are being discouraged in favour of administration.

stories.title: Sat Sharma calls Article 370 a closed chapter
stories.summary: BJP president Sat Sharma has criticised National Conference leader Farooq Abdullah for demanding the restoration of Article 370. Sharma noted that the 2019 decision was upheld by the Supreme Court. He suggested the party focus on government performance instead.

stories.title: IIT Roorkee postpones exams following student death
stories.summary: IIT Roorkee has postponed 70 examinations to November 22 following the death of a second-year student. The incident occurred on campus, and police were notified on Thursday. The academic schedule has been adjusted accordingly.

stories.title: Corporal punishment persists in Indian classrooms
stories.summary: A parent reported that a teacher in a Chennai government school hit students, including her daughter, for missing assignments. The teacher reportedly stopped the practice after parents threatened to involve the police. Corporal punishment remains a challenge in some classrooms.

stories.title: The silent cost of India’s research boom on classrooms
stories.summary: Indian assistant professors are required by UGC norms to teach at least 16 hours per week while maintaining research output. Data suggests this dual expectation is impacting research integrity, classroom quality, and faculty well-being. The system expects two full-time jobs to occupy one person indefinitely.

stories.title: Are schools equipping students for higher education or merely training them to ace exams?
stories.summary: First-year commerce students who scored over 90 percent in secondary exams are struggling to prepare a simple trial balance. While schools focus on memorising theory and formats, higher education assumes students have developed practical competence. The gap between testing and application remains wide.

stories.title: Facing the differences
stories.summary: Aradhya Menon, a teenager from Thrissur, reports receiving unsolicited warnings and commentary while learning to drive an electric scooter. Her experience highlights persistent societal attitudes regarding gender and independence. Such exposure to discriminatory feedback often begins at a very young age in India.

stories.title: TN govt secures price cut in free bicycles for students after negotiations
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has negotiated a reduction in the procurement cost of free bicycles for students, lowering prices by over 27 percent for boys and nearly 32 percent for girls. Initial costs were fixed at over 7,000 rupees per unit. The scheme began in 2001.

stories.title: UAFS marks International Education Week, encourages study abroad
stories.summary: The University of Arkansas-Fort Smith will observe International Education Week from November 16 to 20. The schedule includes a public Culture Fest and various activities intended to highlight the benefits of international education. The university aims to keep the campus busy during the designated week.

stories.title: SCU international student program faces major policy shifts
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security proposed a 70,000 dollar fee for foreign student work programs on October 7, 2026. This follows proposals to limit student visas to four years. These restrictions on study abroad programs are part of a series of ongoing policy changes for U.S. universities.
